name: Illustrate every new story saved to a Google Drive folder
description: Starts the Illustrator whenever the author saves a new story to the stories folder in Google Drive.
shortDescription: Start the story illustrator whenever a new story lands in a Google Drive folder.
keyFeatures: Google Drive trigger on a stories folder
Reads the story from Google Docs
Calls the story illustrator workflow as a subflow
prerequisites: Google Drive and Google Docs connections
The Illustrate a story template imported and published in the same project; replace REPLACE_WITH_ILLUSTRATOR_WORKFLOW_UUID with its workflow UUID
A Google Drive folder for new stories; replace REPLACE_WITH_STORIES_FOLDER_ID
idealFor: Writers who keep stories as Google Docs and want each one illustrated as soon as it is saved.
steps: Trigger: a new file appears in the stories folder in Google Drive.
Read the story from Google Docs.
Run the illustrator workflow with the story title and text.
